entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Player Companion: Heroes of the Darklands
entity_raw.definition_raw:
You have a sixth sense for the valuable treasures of the earth.

Benefit(s): You gain a +4 bonus on Perception checks to notice natural deposits of precious metals or minerals, and a +4 bonus on Appraise checks to determine their worth. By spending 5 minutes scrutinizing a discovered vein of metals or minerals, you can determine the worth of the full vein to within 1,000 gp, to a maximum of 50,000 gp.
